search.snippet: A tinderbox can be bought in most general stores. It is also used to light and relight candles and lanterns, so any player venturing into a dark area such as the Lumbridge Caves should bring one in case their light source goes out.
search.title: Tinderbox - OSRS Wiki

search.snippet: A damp tinderbox is made when a player falls into the water with a tinderbox on the 5th level of the Abandoned Mine. This renders the tinderbox useless and unable to light any type of light source.
search.title: Damp tinderbox - OSRS Wiki

search.snippet: Searching certain shelves of the Wise Old Man 's home gives a tinderbox, possibly book (s) and a message questioning why he keeps so many tinderboxes. This is likely due to Dionysus's eventual assault upon the Wizards' Tower.
search.title: Tinderbox - Old School RuneScape Wiki

search.snippet: Do you wish to take one? The search dialogue was updated. Six crates containing tinderboxes can be found in the warehouse in Marim on Ape Atoll. The crate can be searched, which takes 4 ticks (2.4s), before the player will then be asked whether they wish to take a tinderbox.
search.title: Crate (tinderbox) - OSRS Wiki

search.snippet: It has the appearance of an item including an orange name and red dot on the minimap, but unlike normal item spawns does not disappear after being picked up. You can only have 5 tinderboxes in your inventory before being told you already have plenty, although drop tricking bypasses this.
search.title: Tinderbox (scenery) - OSRS Wiki

search.snippet: The Iron full helm is a full helm made of iron. It is the second weakest full helmet available. While it grants greater defensive stats than its medium helmet counterpart, it has worse magic and ranged attack stats. There are no Defence requirements for wearing this helmet.
